en: Black‑and‑white view of a European small‑town street and square. On the left stands a grand late‑19th‑century corner hotel or villa with ornate façades and a sign reading "PARZIVAL" on the roofline. Shopfronts occupy the ground floor. On the right is a simpler gabled house with commercial signs painted along the walls, and a metal utility pole in the foreground. Several adults and children in early‑20th‑century clothing stand in the cobbled street. Low hills or forest rise in the background.
